main_text.l: Christi officio, nullo artificio elici posse. §.9.
Potestatem hanc Coactiuam, vt per se iniustam, ita
per multas Annorum centurias ignotam penitus fuisse. §.10.
Ex veræ Ouis notâ primariâ ostendi, Papam non Pa-
storis, sed tyranni partes agere. §.11.
In arietibus debellandis infeliciter Bellarminum aciem struere. §.12.
Formulam Bellarm. (Reclvdendi Principes) atrocES
in Principes iniurias innuere; cui typus pastoralis
Pedi reclamat. §.13.
Causas deponendi Principes plures indignas, multas
ineptas, iustas esse nullas. §.14.
Causæ superiores, propter quas Principes deponen-
dos censent Pontificij, sigillatim recensentur; & eorum
omnium Pontificum ipsi rei peraguntur. §.15.
Papam negotijs multis à prædicandi munere impe-
diri; otiosè obtendi. §.16.
Papam per Vicarium, non per se concionantem, om-
ni iudicio tam humano quàm diuino damnandum: & ex
ipsis verbis Christi [Pasce Oves] Pastoris nomine in-
dignum probari. §.17.
Quo sensu Principes Sacerdotum, adeoque Pontifi-
cum ipsorum Pastores iure haberi debeant. §.18.
In CAP. III.
De III. Tit. Papæ, vz. Doctor, vel Iudex.
Titulum Doctoris, communem Alijs, Pontifici pro-
prium Monarchiam stabilire non posse. §.1.
Papam in Conc. Florentino speciem magis quàm vim
authoritatis habuisse. §.2.
Papam Concilio subesse. §.3.
Sensum verborum Christi [Confirma Fratres]
celebriorem & veriorem Bellarminianæ expositioni ad-
versari. §.4.
Illud [Non deficiat] Non uni Petro proprium,
sed alijs Apostolis charisma commune esse. §.5.
Per-

page.notes: Top of the page: the running head "Elenchus." is set in italic with a fleuron-like rule above and below. The first paragraph starts mid-page with a fragment from the previous page, so it is marked cont="true". The final line "Per-" is a hyphenated word continuing onto the next page; it is also the catchword. Section numbers at line ends (§.9 etc.) are part of the printed text. Some words are uncertain due to scan quality: "Papam" in "Papam Concilio subesse" and the marks "[?]" are not needed as readings are clear. Reading of the Greek-free page is complete; no Greek or Hebrew appears here. The "Google" watermark at the bottom right is a digitiser's mark and is omitted. The column has no marginal notes.
